    o.bf_1y_inter_1m_sum_down,

    o.abf_1y_inter_3m_count_down,
    o.abf_1y_inter_1m_sum_up,
    o.abf_1y_inter_1m_sum_down,
    o.abf_1y_inter_1m_count_up,
    o.abf_1y_inter_1m_count_down
FROM (
        SELECT
            s.${s_topic_field},
            s.${s_mdl_dte_field},
            f.uid,
            f.rsi_bf_9m_inter_1m,
            f.rsi_bf_6m_inter_1m,
            f.rsi_bf_3m_inter_1m,
            f.rsi_bf_1y_inter_3m,
            f.rsi_bf_1y_inter_1m,
            f.rsi_af_9m_inter_1m,
            f.rsi_af_6m_inter_1m,
            f.rsi_af_3m_inter_1m,
            f.rsi_af_1y_inter_3m,
            f.rsi_af_1y_inter_1m,
            f.rsi_abf_1y_inter_3m,
            f.rsi_abf_1y_inter_1m,
            f.mdl_dte,
            f.ds,
            f.bf_q4_q3_trend,
            f.bf_q3_q2_trend,
            f.bf_q2_q1_trend,
            f.bf_9m_inter_1m_sum_up,
            f.bf_9m_inter_1m_sum_down,
            f.bf_9m_inter_1m_count_up,
            f.bf_9m_inter_1m_count_down,
            f.bf_6m_trend,
            f.bf_6m_inter_1m_sum_up,
            f.bf_6m_inter_1m_sum_down,
            f.bf_6m_inter_1m_count_up,
            f.bf_6m_inter_1m_count_down,
            f.bf_3m_inter_1m_sum_up,
            f.bf_3m_inter_1m_sum_down,
            f.bf_3m_inter_1m_count_up,
            f.bf_3m_inter_1m_count_down,
            f.bf_1y_inter_3m_sum_up,
            f.bf_1y_inter_3m_sum_down,
            f.bf_1y_inter_3m_count_up,
            f.bf_1y_inter_3m_count_down,
            f.bf_1y_inter_1m_sum_up,
            f.bf_1y_inter_1m_sum_down,
            f.bf_1y_inter_1m_count_up,
            f.bf_1y_inter_1m_count_down,
            f.bf_1m_trend,
            f.af_q4_q3_trend,
            f.af_q3_q2_trend,
            f.af_q2_q1_trend,
            f.af_9m_inter_1m_sum_up,
            f.af_9m_inter_1m_sum_down,
            f.af_9m_inter_1m_count_up,
            f.af_9m_inter_1m_count_down,
            f.af_6m_trend,
            f.af_6m_inter_1m_sum_up,
            f.af_6m_inter_1m_sum_down,
            f.af_6m_inter_1m_count_up,
            f.af_6m_inter_1m_count_down,
            f.af_3m_inter_1m_sum_up,
            f.af_3m_inter_1m_sum_down,
            f.af_3m_inter_1m_count_up,
            f.af_3m_inter_1m_count_down,
            f.af_1y_inter_3m_sum_up,
            f.af_1y_inter_3m_sum_down,
            f.af_1y_inter_3m_count_up,
            f.af_1y_inter_3m_count_down,
            f.af_1y_inter_1m_sum_up,
            f.af_1y_inter_1m_sum_down,
            f.af_1y_inter_1m_count_up,
            f.af_1y_inter_1m_count_down,
            f.af_1m_trend,
            f.abf_1y_inter_3m_sum_up,
            f.abf_1y_inter_3m_sum_down,
            f.abf_1y_inter_3m_count_up,
            f.abf_1y_inter_3m_count_down,
            f.abf_1y_inter_1m_sum_up,
            f.abf_1y_inter_1m_sum_down,
            f.abf_1y_inter_1m_count_up,
            f.abf_1y_inter_1m_count_down,
            row_number() over(partition by s.${s_topic_field} order by f.ds desc) as rn
        FROM ${sample_table} s
        LEFT JOIN (
                    SELECT
                        *
                    FROM
                        dwa_risk.dwa_risk_dz_model_final_23changzhai_trend_df
                    WHERE
                        to_date(to_date(ds,'yyyyMMdd')) >= ${min_ds}
                    AND
                        ds <= ${max_ds}
                    ) f
        ON
            s.${s_topic_field} = f.uid
        AND
            datediff(to_date(s.${s_mdl_dte_field}),to_date(f.ds ,'yyyyMMdd')) = 0
    ) o  WHERE rn=1;
